queue.name: Texas Eastern Line 31 Expansion Project (Line 31 Loop and Line 14-P Lateral)
queue.note: Retry of the 10-16 monitor shard line-31-expansion-project, which held it for lack of a data center tie. Texas Eastern expansion with no row of its own: 10.2 mi 36-inch Line 31 loop plus a 1.6 mi 16-inch lateral, 125,000 Dth/d, FERC CP26-75, in service September 2028, feeding Entergy Mississippi's Traceview plant in Ridgeland. New lead: a Mississippi Free Press article from August 2026 says the Amazon deal fast-tracked Entergy's Ridgeland plant, and the MDEQ response to comments places Traceview next to the Amazon Data Services Ridgeland facility. Neither page names the pipeline (I checked both), and the adjacency point comes from commenters, so vetting must find a ref naming this pipeline and data centers before setting DataCenter = yes. Otherwise it stays monitor. Expansion row shape under 'Texas Eastern Transmission (TETCO) Gas Pipeline'.

evidence.note: FERC scoping notice, CP26-75: 10.2 mi 36-in Line 31 loop and 1.6 mi 16-in lateral to Entergy Mississippi Traceview plant, Madison County

MDEQ air permit comments: Traceview 750 MW plant sits next to the AWS data center campus at County Line Road, Ridgeland

seed_ledger.name: Pine Prairie Energy Center Phase IV Storage Expansion
seed_ledger.reason: Checked EIA row, FERC docket CP25-533 as summarized by trade press, and web news. Project adds a sixth cavern (about 10 Bcf), about 2.37 miles (3.8 km) of new 30-inch header loop and added compression. Williams states purpose as utility, industrial, power and LNG demand. No source ties it to a data center, so held as monitor with length known.

evidence.note: Williams storage expansion at Pine Prairie
